name: pa-court-docs
description: Draft and format pleadings, motions, and orders for Pennsylvania trial courts. Applies Pa. R.C.P. Nos. 1023-1025 format (caption, signature blocks, verification) and PACFile mandatory e-filing. Covers Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas (First Judicial District), Allegheny County Court of Common Pleas (Fifth Judicial District), and a populous-counties roll-up; a dedicated pa-mdj skill for the Magisterial District Judge (MDJ) tier (small claims / landlord-tenant / summary offenses, the primary consumer-debt and eviction forum); and pa-family-court for the Family Division. Pennsylvania-specific: Pa. R.C.P. 1034/1035 (demurrer/judgment on pleadings/summary judgment); 4-year contract SOL (42 Pa. C.S. § 5525); 2-year personal-injury SOL (§ 5524); 2-year UTPCPL SOL; Pennsylvania Unfair Trade Practices and Consumer Protection Law (UTPCPL, 73 P.S. § 201-1 et seq.); Fair Credit Extension Uniformity Act (FCEUA). Subject-matter bundles: pa-consumer-debt (FDCPA, FCEUA, UTPCPL), pa-family-law, pa-landlord-tenant, pa-personal-injury (modified comparative fault, § 7102), pa-employment, pa-commercial-disputes.
